title: A successful final command can hide the script deadline
detail: At 8bf2930b0, an attn_do call can report success after its deadline when a final browser command completes before the hard child stop. The command's confirmed change appears in the ledger without a timeout indication. This contradicts D28. Record the elapsed deadline in the final response even when the last command succeeds, while retaining the completed command in the ledger. Source: internal/daemon/agent_script.go:75-77 and :168-175. Two independent stepped-clock functional wire tests confirmed the discrepancy. Evidence on s-qesymt.
